headline: Growth items at home
title: Growth Fruit | Craft Free EXP at Home | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo has three EXP items. A Growth Bud gives one thousand EXP, a Growth Flower five thousand, and a Growth Fruit twenty five thousand. That means one Fruit equals twenty five Buds. You can make them at home in the Dance Pad Polisher with a Lightning worker. Eight Roses make a Growth Fruit, and the Fruit recipe needs a level three Polisher and a level three Lightning worker. Will you farm Roses? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Growth Bud gives 1,000 EXP, Growth Flower 5,000 and Growth Fruit 25,000. Craft them in the Dance Pad Polisher with a Lightning worker; the Fruit takes 8 Roses and needs a level 3 Polisher and Lightning level 3.
